description: This file defines an editor plugin for handling component blocks within a Slate.js rich text editor, including normalization, insertion, normalization, and structure validation for component-related constructs.

methods.name: getAncestorComponentBlock
methods.description: Retrieves the nearest ancestor component block element from the current selection in the editor.

methods.name: normalizeNodeWithinComponentProp
methods.description: Recursively normalizes nodes within a component property based on their schema and document features, ensuring consistency.

methods.name: canSchemaContainChildField
methods.description: Determines if a given schema can contain a child field.

methods.name: doesSchemaOnlyEverContainASingleChildField
methods.description: Checks if the root schema contains only a single child field.

methods.name: findArrayFieldsWithSingleChildField
methods.description: Finds array fields within a schema that contain only a single child field.

methods.name: isEmptyChildFieldNode
methods.description: Checks whether a component prop node is empty based on its type and children.

methods.name: withComponentBlocks
methods.description: Enhances an editor instance to support component block handling, including normalization, insertion, deletion, and structural integrity.

methods.name: addMissingFields
methods.description: Adds missing fields to a value based on a component schema, initializing missing properties with default values.
